/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. state
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const state = {
  view: "month",
  cursor: startOfDay(new Date()),
  now: Date.now(),
  speed: 60,             // 60× so reminders are observable; 0 = paused
  calendars: [], events: [], notifications: [],
  delivered: {}, snoozes: {},
  detail: null, editing: null, notifTab: "all", notifOpen: false
};

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const el = (tag, cls, html) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (html != null) n.innerHTML = html; return n; };
const esc = s => String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&":"&","<":"<",">":">",'"':""","'":"'" }[c]));

function load(){
  let data = null;
  try { data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY) || "null"); } catch(e){ data = null; }
  if (!data || !data.calendars) data = seed();
  state.calendars = data.calendars;
  state.events = data.events;
  state.notifications = data.notifications || [];
  state.delivered = data.delivered || {};
  state.snoozes = data.snoozes || {};
}
function save(){
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      calendars: state.calendars, events: state.events,
      notifications: state.notifications.slice(0,60),
      delivered: state.delivered, snoozes: state.snoozes
    }));
  } catch(e){ /* quota: prototype only */ }
}
const calById = id => state.calendars.find(c => c.id === id) || null;
const isVisible = ev => ev.calendar_ids.some(id => { const c = calById(id); return c && c.visible; });
const primaryCal = ev => calById(ev.calendar_ids[0]) || { color:"#888", name:"—" };

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. recurrence + occurrence expansion  (bounded, prototype-grade)
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function parseRRule(str){
  const out = { freq:"DAILY", interval:1, byday:null, until:null, count:null };
  if (!str) return out;
  const map = { FREQ:v=>out.freq=v, INTERVAL:v=>out.interval=Math.max(1,parseInt(v,10)||1),
                BYDAY:v=>out.byday=v.split(","), UNTIL:v=>out.until=v, COUNT:v=>out.count=parseInt(v,10), };
  str.split(";").forEach(part => { const [k,v] = part.split("="); if (map[k]) map[k](v); });
  return out;
}
const WD = { SU:0, MO:1, TU:2, WE:3, TH:4, FR:5, SA:6 };

function eventOccurrences(ev, rangeStart, rangeEnd){
  const s0 = pdate(ev.start), e0 = pdate(ev.end);
  if (!s0 || !e0) return [];
  const dur = Math.max(MIN, e0 - s0);
  const out = [];
  const push = (start) => out.push({
    key: ev.id + "|" + isoLocal(start),
    event: ev, start, end: new Date(start.getTime() + dur),
    calendar_ids: ev.calendar_ids, source: ev.source, refs: ev.refs || {},
    all_day: !!ev.all_day, read_only: ev.calendar_ids.every(id => (calById(id)||{}).read_only)
  });

  if (!ev.recurrence || !ev.recurrence.rrule){
    if (s0 < rangeEnd && e0 > rangeStart) push(s0);
    return out;
  }

  const rule = parseRRule(ev.recurrence.rrule);
  const until = rule.until
    ? new Date(+rule.until.slice(0,4), +rule.until.slice(4,6)-1, +rule.until.slice(6,8), 23, 59)
    : null;
  // Walk day by day over the window (+alignment), the matcher is order-independent.
  const from = Math.max(startOfDay(s0).getTime(), rangeStart.getTime() - dur - 32*DAY);
  const to   = Math.min(rangeEnd.getTime(), until ? until.getTime() : rangeEnd.getTime());
  let generated = 0, guard = 0;
  for (let t = from; t <= to && guard < 1200; t += DAY, guard++){
    const d = new Date(t);
    const diff = daysBetween(s0, d);
    if (diff < 0) continue;
    const dow = (d.getDay()+6)%7;                       // 0 = Monday
    let hit = false;
    if (rule.freq === "DAILY")       hit = diff % rule.interval === 0;
    else if (rule.freq === "WEEKLY") hit = Math.floor(diff/7) % rule.interval === 0 &&
                                            (!rule.byday || rule.byday.includes(Object.keys(WD).find(k => WD[k] === d.getDay())));
    else if (rule.freq === "MONTHLY"){ const md = (d.getFullYear()-s0.getFullYear())*12 + (d.getMonth()-s0.getMonth());
                                        hit = md % rule.interval === 0 && d.getDate() === s0.getDate(); }
    if (!hit) continue;
    generated++;
    if (rule.count && generated > rule.count) break;
    const start = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate(), s0.getHours(), s0.getMinutes());
    const end = new Date(start.getTime() + dur);
    if (start < rangeEnd && end > rangeStart) push(start);
  }
  return out;
}

function occurrencesBetween(from, to, opts){
  const includeHidden = opts && opts.includeHidden;
  let occs = [];
  for (const ev of state.events){
    if (!includeHidden && !isVisible(ev)) continue;
    occs = occs.concat(eventOccurrences(ev, from, to));
  }
  return occs.sort((a,b) => a.start - b.start);
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. notifications + reminders
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function pushNotification(n){
  state.notifications.unshift(Object.assign({ id:"n_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9),
    at:Date.now(), read:false, kind:"system" }, n));
  if (state.notifications.length > 80) state.notifications.length = 80;
  renderBell(); renderNotifPanel(); save();
}
const unreadCount = () => state.notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length;

function renderBell(){
  const badge = $("#notif-badge"), n = unreadCount();
  badge.hidden = n === 0;
  badge.textContent = n > 99 ? "99+" : String(n);
}

function remindersOf(ev, occ){
  if (occ.read_only) return ev.reminders || [];
  const list = (ev.reminders || []).slice();
  if (!list.length){
    const cal = primaryCal(ev);
    (cal.default_reminders || []).forEach(r => list.push(r));
  }
  return list;
}

/** Fires every simulated minute. Mirrors the server tick (analysis §7). */
function checkReminders(catchUpMs){
  const now = state.now;
  const lookBack = catchUpMs || 0;
  const occs = occurrencesBetween(new Date(now - 6*HOUR), new Date(now + 3*DAY), { includeHidden:true });
  for (const occ of occs){
    const keys = [];
    for (const r of remindersOf(occ.event, occ)){
      const trig = occ.start.getTime() - (r.minutes_before||0)*MIN;
      const key = `${occ.event.id}|${isoLocal(occ.start)}|${r.minutes_before}`;
      if (state.delivered[key]) continue;
      if (trig <= now && trig >= now - lookBack){ keys.push({ key, r }); }
    }
    // snnooze re-fires
    const skey = `${occ.event.id}|${isoLocal(occ.start)}`;
    if (state.snoozes[skey] && state.snoozes[skey].at <= now){
      delete state.snoozes[skey];
      fireReminder(occ, { minutes_before:0, snoozed:true });
    }
    for (const { key, r } of keys){
      state.delivered[key] = new Date(now).toISOString();
      fireReminder(occ, r);
    }
  }
  pruneDelivered();
  save();
}

function pruneDelivered(){
  const limit = Date.now() - 30*DAY;
  Object.keys(state.delivered).forEach(k => {
    if (new Date(state.delivered[k]).getTime() < limit) delete state.delivered[k];
  });
}

function fireReminder(occ, r){
  const ev = occ.event;
  const when = occ.all_day ? "all day" : fmtTimeRange(occ.start, occ.end);
  pushNotification({
    kind:"reminder", title:ev.title, body:`${when} · ${primaryCal(ev).name}`,
    eventId:ev.id, occurrenceKey:occ.key, minutesBefore:r.minutes_before
  });
  showToast(occ, r);
  $("#sr-status").textContent = `Reminder: ${ev.title} at ${when}`;
}

function showToast(occ, r){
  const ev = occ.event, cal = primaryCal(ev);
  const when = occ.all_day ? "all day" : fmtTimeRange(occ.start, occ.end);
  const lead = r.snoozed ? "Snoozed reminder" : (r.minutes_before === 0 ? "Starting now" : `In ${r.minutes_before} min`);
  const t = el("div", "toast");
  t.style.setProperty("--cc", cal.color);
  t.innerHTML = `
    <div class="bar" style="background:${cal.color}"></div>
    <div class="in">
      <div class="kick" style="color:${cal.color}">🔔 ${esc(lead)}</div>
      <h4>${esc(ev.title)}</h4>
      <p>${esc(when)}${ev.location ? " · " + esc(ev.location) : ""}</p>
    </div>
    <div class="acts">
      <button class="btn" data-act="open">Open</button>
      <button class="btn" data-act="snooze">Snooze 5 min</button>
      <button class="btn danger" data-act="dismiss">Dismiss</button>
    </div>`;
  const close = () => { t.remove(); };
  t.querySelector('[data-act="open"]').onclick = () => { close(); openDetail(occ); };
  t.querySelector('[data-act="snooze"]').onclick = () => {
    state.snoozes[`${ev.id}|${isoLocal(occ.start)}`] = { at: state.now + 5*MIN };
    pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"Reminder snoozed 5 min", body:ev.title });
    save(); close();
  };
  t.querySelector('[data-act="dismiss"]').onclick = close;
  $("#toasts").appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(() => { if (t.isConnected) close(); }, 45000);
}

function renderNotifPanel(){
  const p = $("#notif-panel");
  const items = state.notifications.filter(n => state.notifTab === "all" || n.kind === state.notifTab);
  p.innerHTML = `
    <header>
      <h3>Notifications</h3>
      <button class="btn icon" data-act="close" title="Close">✕</button>
    </header>
    <div class="tabs" id="ntabs">
      <button data-tab="all" aria-selected="${state.notifTab==="all"}">All</button>
      <button data-tab="reminder" aria-selected="${state.notifTab==="reminder"}">Reminders</button>
      <button data-tab="system" aria-selected="${state.notifTab==="system"}">System</button>
    </div>
    <div class="nlist">
      ${items.length ? items.map(n => `
        <div class="nitem ${n.read ? "" : "unread"} ${n.missed ? "missed" : ""}" data-id="${n.id}">
          <div class="ico">${n.kind === "reminder" ? "🔔" : "⚡"}</div>
          <div class="txt">
            <div class="ttl">${esc(n.title || "")}${n.missed ? ' <span class="tag">missed</span>' : ""}</div>
            <div class="sub">${esc(n.body || "")}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="when">${fmtTime(new Date(n.at))}</div>
        </div>`).join("") : `<div class="empty">No ${state.notifTab === "all" ? "" : state.notifTab + " "}notifications</div>`}
    </div>
    <div class="nfooter">
      <button class="btn" data-act="readall">Mark all read</button>
      <button class="btn danger" data-act="clear">Clear</button>
    </div>`;

  p.querySelector('[data-act="close"]').onclick = () => toggleNotif(false);
  p.querySelectorAll("#ntabs button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { state.notifTab = b.dataset.tab; renderNotifPanel(); });
  p.querySelectorAll(".nitem").forEach(node => node.onclick = () => {
    const n = state.notifications.find(x => x.id === node.dataset.id);
    if (!n) return;
    n.read = true; renderBell(); renderNotifPanel(); save();
    if (n.eventId){
      const ev = state.events.find(e => e.id === n.eventId);
      if (ev) openDetail({ event:ev, start:pdate(ev.start), end:pdate(ev.end),
        calendar_ids:ev.calendar_ids, all_day:ev.all_day, source:ev.source, refs:ev.refs||{},
        read_only:ev.calendar_ids.every(id => (calById(id)||{}).read_only) });
    }
  });
  p.querySelector('[data-act="readall"]').onclick = () => {
    state.notifications.forEach(n => n.read = true); renderBell(); renderNotifPanel(); save();
  };
  p.querySelector('[data-act="clear"]').onclick = () => {
    state.notifications = state.notifications.filter(n => !n.read); renderBell(); renderNotifPanel(); save();
  };
}
function toggleNotif(force){
  state.notifOpen = force === undefined ? !state.notifOpen : force;
  $("#notif-panel").classList.toggle("open", state.notifOpen);
  if (state.notifOpen) renderNotifPanel();
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. rendering — sidebar
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderSidebar(){
  const mine = state.calendars.filter(c => c.kind !== "system" && c.kind !== "external");
  const other = state.calendars.filter(c => c.kind === "system" || c.kind === "external");
  const row = c => {
    const count = state.events.filter(e => e.calendar_ids.includes(c.id)).length;
    const n = el("button", "cal-row" + (c.read_only ? " readonly" : ""));
    n.style.setProperty("--cc", c.color);
    n.innerHTML = `
      <span class="cal-check ${c.visible ? "" : "off"}"><svg width="9" height="9" viewBox="0 0 10 10">
        <path d="M1 5.2 L3.7 8 L9 2.2" fill="none" stroke="#101114" stroke-width="2"
          stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
      <span class="cal-name">${esc(c.name)}</span>
      ${c.read_only ? '<span class="tag ro">ro</span>' : ""}
      <span class="meta">${count}</span>`;
    n.querySelector(".cal-check").onclick = ev => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      c.visible = !c.visible; save(); renderAll();
    };
    n.onclick = () => { if (!c.read_only) openCalendarEditor(c); };
    return n;
  };
  const list = $("#cal-list"), olist = $("#cal-list-other");
  list.innerHTML = ""; olist.innerHTML = "";
  mine.forEach(c => list.appendChild(row(c)));
  other.forEach(c => olist.appendChild(row(c)));
}

function renderMini(){
  const c = state.cursor;
  const first = new Date(c.getFullYear(), c.getMonth(), 1);
  const gridStart = startOfWeek(first);
  const html = [`<div class="mini-head">
      <span class="mini-title">${MON[c.getMonth()]} ${c.getFullYear()}</span>
      <span><button class="btn ghost" data-nav="-1" style="padding:0 6px">‹</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" data-nav="1" style="padding:0 6px">›</button></span>
    </div>`,
    '<div class="mini-grid">',
    DOW.map(d => `<div class="dow">${d[0]}</div>`).join("")].join("");
  let out = html;
  for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++){
    const d = addDays(gridStart, i);
    const other = d.getMonth() !== c.getMonth();
    const today = sameDay(d, new Date());
    const cur = sameDay(d, c);
    const occ = occurrencesBetween(startOfDay(d), new Date(startOfDay(d).getTime() + DAY));
    const colors = [...new Set(occ.map(o => primaryCal(o.event).color))].slice(0,3);
    out += `<button class="mini-day ${other ? "other" : ""} ${today ? "today" : ""} ${cur && !today ? "cursor" : ""}"
      data-day="${dateKey(d)}">${d.getDate()}
      <span class="mini-dots">${colors.map(col => `<i style="background:${col}"></i>`).join("")}</span></button>`;
  }
  out += "</div>";
  const node = $("#mini");
  node.innerHTML = out;
  node.querySelectorAll("[data-nav]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    state.cursor = addMonths(state.cursor, parseInt(b.dataset.nav,10)); renderAll();
  });
  node.querySelectorAll("[data-day]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const [y,m,dd] = b.dataset.day.split("-").map(Number);
    state.cursor = new Date(y, m-1, dd); renderAll();
  });
}

function chipHtml(occ, cls){
  const ev = occ.event, cals = ev.calendar_ids.map(calById).filter(Boolean);
  const c1 = cals[0] ? cals[0].color : "#888";
  const c2 = cals[1] ? cals[1].color : c1;
  const multi = cals.length > 1;
  const time = occ.all_day ? "" : `<span class="t">${fmtTime(occ.start)}</span> `;
  const badges = [];
  if (occ.source === "task") badges.push(`<span class="badge-src ${occ.refs.task_status === "done" ? "" : ""}">task</span>`);
  if (occ.source === "orchestration") badges.push('<span class="badge-src">run</span>');
  if (occ.source === "meet") badges.push('<span class="badge-src">meet</span>');
  if (occ.source === "external") badges.push('<span class="badge-src">ics</span>');
  const dots = multi ? `<span class="dots">${cals.slice(0,3).map(c => `<i style="background:${c.color}"></i>`).join("")}</span>` : "";
  const past = occ.end < new Date(state.now) ? " past" : "";
  return `<button class="chip ${multi ? "multi" : ""} ${cls || ""}${past}"
      style="--cc:${c1};--cc2:${c2}" data-key="${occ.key}"
      title="${esc(ev.title)} · ${esc(cals.map(c => c.name).join(" + "))}">
      ${time}<b style="font-weight:600">${esc(ev.title)}</b>${badges.length ? `<span class="badges">${badges.join("")}</span>` : ""}${dots}
    </button>`;
}

function renderHeader(range){
  $("#range-label").textContent = range;
  document.querySelectorAll("#view-switch button").forEach(b => {
    b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(b.dataset.view === state.view));
  });
}

function renderMonth(){
  const c = state.cursor;
  const gridStart = startOfWeek(new Date(c.getFullYear(), c.getMonth(), 1));
  renderHeader(`${MON[c.getMonth()]} ${c.getFullYear()}`);
  const gridEnd = addDays(gridStart, 42);
  const occs = occurrencesBetween(gridStart, gridEnd);
  const byDay = {};
  occs.forEach(o => {
    const span = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((startOfDay(o.end) - startOfDay(o.start)) / DAY) || 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < span; i++){
      const d = addDays(o.start, i);
      const k = dateKey(d);
      (byDay[k] = byDay[k] || []).push(o);
    }
  });

  let html = '<div class="month"><div class="month-head">' + DOW.map(d => `<div>${d}</div>`).join("") + "</div>";
  html += '<div class="month-body">';
  for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++){
    const d = addDays(gridStart, i);
    const other = d.getMonth() !== c.getMonth();
    const today = sameDay(d, new Date());
    const items = (byDay[dateKey(d)] || []).sort((a,b) => {
      if (a.all_day !== b.all_day) return a.all_day ? -1 : 1;
      return a.start - b.start;
    });
    const shown = items.slice(0, 3), extra = items.length - shown.length;
    html += `<div class="mcell ${other ? "other" : ""} ${today ? "today" : ""}" data-day="${dateKey(d)}">
      <button class="clickzone" data-create="${dateKey(d)}" aria-label="Create event on ${dateKey(d)}"></button>
      <span class="num">${d.getDate()}</span>
      <div style="position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px">
        ${shown.map(o => o.all_day && o.end.getDate() !== o.start.getDate()
            ? chipHtml(o) : chipHtml(o)).join("")}
        ${extra > 0 ? `<button class="more" data-more="${dateKey(d)}">+${extra} more…</button>` : ""}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
  html += "</div></div>";
  $("#view").innerHTML = html;

  $("#view").querySelectorAll("[data-create]").forEach(b => b.onclick = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const [y,m,dd] = b.dataset.create.split("-").map(Number);
    openEventEditor(null, new Date(y, m-1, dd, 9, 0));
  });
  $("#view").querySelectorAll("[data-more]").forEach(b => b.onclick = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const [y,m,dd] = b.dataset.more.split("-").map(Number);
    state.cursor = new Date(y, m-1, dd); state.view = "day"; renderAll();
  });
  bindChips();
}

function laneLayout(occs){
  // simple greedy lane assignment for overlapping timed events of one day
  const sorted = occs.slice().sort((a,b) => a.start - b.start || b.end - a.end);
  const lanes = [];
  sorted.forEach(o => {
    let placed = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < lanes.length; i++){
      if (lanes[i] <= o.start){ lanes[i] = o.end; o._lane = i; placed = true; break; }
    }
    if (!placed){ o._lane = lanes.length; lanes.push(o.end); }
  });
  return { items: sorted, lanes: Math.max(1, lanes.length) };
}

function renderTimeGrid(days){
  const c = state.cursor;
  const gridStart = startOfWeek(days.length === 1 ? c : c);
  const cols = days.length;
  renderHeader(cols === 7
    ? `${MON[gridStart.getMonth()]} ${gridStart.getFullYear()} · week of ${gridStart.getDate()}`
    : fmtDay(c));

  const from = startOfDay(gridStart), to = addDays(from, cols);
  const occs = occurrencesBetween(from, to);
  const timedByDay = {}, allDayByDay = {};
  occs.forEach(o => {
    const k = dateKey(o.start);
    if (o.all_day) (allDayByDay[k] = allDayByDay[k] || []).push(o);
    else (timedByDay[k] = timedByDay[k] || []).push(o);
  });

  const min5 = 5*MIN;
  let html = "";
  html += '<div class="week-head"><div class="corner"></div>';
  for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++){
    const d = addDays(gridStart, i);
    html += `<div class="day-head ${sameDay(d, new Date()) ? "today" : ""}">
      <div class="dow">${DOW[i]}</div><div class="num">${d.getDate()}</div></div>`;
  }
  html += "</div>";

  const hasAllDay = Object.keys(allDayByDay).length > 0;
  if (hasAllDay){
    html += '<div class="allday-row"><div class="label">all day</div>';
    for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++){
      const d = addDays(gridStart, i);
      const items = (allDayByDay[dateKey(d)] || []);
      html += `<div class="allday-cell">${items.map(o => `<button class="chip"
        style="--cc:${primaryCal(o.event).color}" data-key="${o.key}">${esc(o.event.title)}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    }
    html += "</div>";
  }

  html += '<div class="scroll" id="gridscroll"><div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:56px repeat(' + cols + ',1fr)">';
  html += '<div class="hours">';
  for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) html += `<div class="hour-lab">${pad2(h)}:00</div>`;
  html += "</div>";

  for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++){
    const d = addDays(gridStart, i);
    const weekend = d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6;
    html += `<div class="day-col ${weekend ? "weekend" : ""}" data-day="${dateKey(d)}">`;
    for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) html += `<div class="slot" data-create="${dateKey(d)}" data-hour="${h}"></div>`;

    const dayStart = startOfDay(d);
    const lay = laneLayout((timedByDay[dateKey(d)] || []));
    lay.items.forEach(o => {
      const top = ((o.start - dayStart) / HOUR) * 44;
      const height = Math.max(18, ((o.end - o.start) / HOUR) * 44 - 2);
      const w = 100 / lay.lanes, left = o._lane * w;
      const cal = primaryCal(o.event);
      html += `<div class="block" data-key="${o.key}" style="top:${top}px;height:${height}px;
        left:calc(${left}% + 2px);width:calc(${w}% - 4px);--cc:${cal.color}"
        title="${esc(o.event.title)} · ${fmtTimeRange(o.start, o.end)}">
        <div class="ttl">${esc(o.event.title)}</div>
        <div class="t">${fmtTimeRange(o.start, o.end)}</div>
        ${o.read_only ? "" : '<div class="resize" title="Resize"></div>'}
      </div>`;
    });
    html += `<div class="nowline" data-now="${dateKey(d)}" hidden></div>`;
    html += "</div>";
  }
  html += "</div></div>";
  $("#view").innerHTML = html;

  $("#view").querySelectorAll("[data-create]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    const [y,m,dd] = b.dataset.create.split("-").map(Number);
    openEventEditor(null, new Date(y, m-1, dd, parseInt(b.dataset.hour,10), 0));
  });
  bindChips(() => true);
  const sc = $("#gridscroll");
  if (sc) sc.scrollTop = 7.5*44;
  updateNowLine();
}

function renderAgenda(){
  const from = startOfDay(state.cursor), to = addDays(from, 30);
  renderHeader(`Agenda · ${fmtShort(from)} → ${fmtShort(addDays(to,-1))}`);
  const occs = occurrencesBetween(from, to);
  const byDay = {};
  occs.forEach(o => { const k = dateKey(o.start); (byDay[k] = byDay[k] || []).push(o); });

  let html = '<div class="agenda">';
  if (!occs.length) html += '<div class="empty">Nothing scheduled in the next 30 days.</div>';
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++){
    const d = addDays(from, i);
    const items = byDay[dateKey(d)];
    if (!items) continue;
    html += `<div class="ag-day ${sameDay(d, new Date()) ? "today" : ""}">
      <h4>${sameDay(d, new Date()) ? "Today · " : ""}${fmtDay(d)}<span class="line"></span></h4>`;
    items.sort((a,b) => (a.all_day === b.all_day) ? a.start - b.start : (a.all_day ? -1 : 1))
      .forEach(o => {
        const cals = o.event.calendar_ids.map(calById).filter(Boolean);
        html += `<div class="ag-row" data-key="${o.key}">
          <div class="ag-time">${o.all_day ? "All day" : fmtTimeRange(o.start, o.end)}</div>
          <div class="ag-main">
            <div class="ag-title">
              <span style="width:3px;height:15px;border-radius:2px;background:${(cals[0]||{}).color};display:inline-block"></span>
              ${esc(o.event.title)}
              ${o.source === "task" ? '<span class="badge-src">task</span>' : ""}
              ${o.source === "orchestration" ? '<span class="badge-src">run</span>' : ""}
              ${o.source === "meet" ? '<span class="badge-src">meet</span>' : ""}
              ${o.source === "external" ? '<span class="badge-src">ics</span>' : ""}
              ${o.read_only ? '<span class="tag ro">read-only</span>' : ""}
            </div>
            <div class="ag-sub">${esc(o.event.location || o.event.description || "")}</div>
            <div class="ag-cal">${cals.map(c => `<i style="background:${c.color}"></i>${esc(c.name)}`).join(" · ")}</div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      });
    html += "</div>";
  }
  html += "</div>";
  $("#view").innerHTML = html;
  bindChips();
}

function bindChips(){
  const all = occurrencesBetween(addDays(startOfDay(state.cursor), -400), addDays(startOfDay(state.cursor), 400), { includeHidden:true });
  const map = new Map(all.map(o => [o.key, o]));
  document.querySelectorAll(".chip[data-key], .block[data-key], .ag-row[data-key]").forEach(node => {
    node.addEventListener("click", e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const occ = map.get(node.dataset.key);
      if (occ) openDetail(occ, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    });
  });
}

function renderAll(){
  renderSidebar(); renderMini(); renderBell();
  if (state.view === "month") renderMonth();
  else if (state.view === "week") renderTimeGrid([0,1,2,3,4,5,6]);
  else if (state.view === "day") renderTimeGrid([0]);
  else renderAgenda();
  renderNotifPanel();
}

function openDetail(occ, x, y){
  const ev = occ.event, cals = ev.calendar_ids.map(calById).filter(Boolean);
  const cal = cals[0] || { color:"#888", name:"—" };
  const srcLabel = { task:"Task", orchestration:"Orchestration run", meet:"Meet", external:"Imported (ICS)", native:"Event" }[occ.source] || "Event";
  const when = occ.all_day
    ? `${fmtDay(occ.start)} · all day`
    : `${fmtDay(occ.start)} · ${fmtTimeRange(occ.start, occ.end)}`;
  const d = $("#detail");
  d.style.setProperty("--cc", cal.color);
  d.innerHTML = `
    <div class="bar"></div>
    <div class="body">
      <h3>${esc(ev.title)}</h3>
      <div class="when">${esc(when)}</div>
      ${ev.location ? `<div class="field"><span>📍</span><span>${esc(ev.location)}</span></div>` : ""}
      ${ev.description ? `<div class="field"><span>📝</span><span>${esc(ev.description)}</span></div>` : ""}
      ${ev.guests && ev.guests.length ? `<div class="field"><span>👥</span><span>${ev.guests.map(esc).join(", ")}</span></div>` : ""}
      <div class="field"><span>🔔</span><span>${
        (ev.reminders && ev.reminders.length)
          ? ev.reminders.map(r => r.minutes_before === 0 ? "at start" : `${r.minutes_before} min before`).join(" · ")
          : (cal.default_reminders && cal.default_reminders.length
              ? `calendar default (${cal.default_reminders.map(r => r.minutes_before).join("/")} min)` : "no reminders")
      }</span></div>
      ${ev.recurrence ? `<div class="field"><span>🔁</span><span>${esc(ev.recurrence.rrule)}</span></div>` : ""}
      <div class="field"><span>🏷</span><span>${esc(srcLabel)}${occ.read_only ? " · read-only" : ""}</span></div>
      <div class="calchips">${cals.map(c => `<span class="calchip"><i style="background:${c.color}"></i>${esc(c.name)}</span>`).join("")}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      ${occ.read_only
        ? `<button class="btn" data-act="source">${occ.source === "task" ? "Open task" : "Open item"}</button>`
        : `<button class="btn" data-act="edit">Edit</button>
           <button class="btn danger" data-act="del">Delete</button>`}
      <button class="btn" data-act="close">Close</button>
    </div>`;
  const w = 330, h = 320;
  const left = Math.min(Math.max(12, (x || window.innerWidth/2) - w/2), window.innerWidth - w - 12);
  const top = Math.min(Math.max(64, (y || 120) - 20), window.innerHeight - h - 12);
  d.style.left = left + "px"; d.style.top = top + "px";
  d.classList.add("open");
  state.detail = occ;

  d.querySelector('[data-act="close"]').onclick = closeDetail;
  const edit = d.querySelector('[data-act="edit"]');
  if (edit) edit.onclick = () => { closeDetail(); openEventEditor(ev); };
  const del = d.querySelector('[data-act="del"]');
  if (del) del.onclick = () => {
    state.events = state.events.filter(e => e.id !== ev.id);
    pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"Event deleted", body:ev.title });
    closeDetail(); save(); renderAll();
  };
  const src = d.querySelector('[data-act="source"]');
  if (src) src.onclick = () => {
    pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"Opening source",
      body: `${srcLabel}: ${ev.title} (prototype: no navigation)` });
  };
}
function closeDetail(){ $("#detail").classList.remove("open"); }

function closeModal(){ $("#backdrop").classList.remove("open"); $("#modal").innerHTML = ""; }

function openEventEditor(ev, defaultStart){
  const isNew = !ev;
  const start = ev ? pdate(ev.start) : (defaultStart || new Date(state.cursor.getFullYear(), state.cursor.getMonth(), state.cursor.getDate(), 9, 0));
  const end = ev ? pdate(ev.end) : new Date(start.getTime() + HOUR);
  const editable = state.calendars.filter(c => !c.read_only);
  const selIds = ev ? ev.calendar_ids.filter(id => { const c = calById(id); return c && !c.read_only; }) : [editable[0] ? editable[0].id : ""];
  const primary = selIds[0] || (editable[0] || {}).id;

  openModal(`
    <header><h2>${isNew ? "New event" : "Edit event"}</h2>
      <button class="btn icon" data-act="close">✕</button></header>
    <div class="content">
      <label class="f">Title
        <input id="f-title" value="${esc(ev ? ev.title : "")}" placeholder="Spec review…" autofocus>
      </label>
      <div class="row">
        <label class="f">Calendar
          <select id="f-cal">
            ${editable.map(c => `<option value="${c.id}" ${c.id === primary ? "selected" : ""}>${esc(c.name)}</option>`).join("")}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label class="f">Repeat
          <select id="f-rep">
            <option value="">Does not repeat</option>
            <option value="DAILY" ${ev && ev.recurrence && /FREQ=DAILY/.test(ev.recurrence.rrule) ? "selected" : ""}>Daily</option>
            <option value="WEEKLY" ${ev && ev.recurrence && /FREQ=WEEKLY/.test(ev.recurrence.rrule) ? "selected" : ""}>Weekly</option>
            <option value="MONTHLY" ${ev && ev.recurrence && /FREQ=MONTHLY/.test(ev.recurrence.rrule) ? "selected" : ""}>Monthly</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
      <label class="checkbox"><input type="checkbox" id="f-allday" ${ev && ev.all_day ? "checked" : ""}> All day</label>
      <div class="row">
        <label class="f">Starts <input type="datetime-local" id="f-start" value="${isoLocal(start)}"></label>
        <label class="f">Ends <input type="datetime-local" id="f-end" value="${isoLocal(end)}"></label>
      </div>
      <div class="row">
        <label class="f">Reminder
          <select id="f-rem">
            <option value="-1">Use calendar default</option>
            <option value="0">At start</option>
            <option value="5">5 min before</option>
            <option value="10">10 min before</option>
            <option value="15">15 min before</option>
            <option value="30">30 min before</option>
            <option value="60">1 hour before</option>
            <option value="180">3 hours before</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label class="f">Second reminder
          <select id="f-rem2">
            <option value="-1">None</option>
            <option value="0">At start</option>
            <option value="5">5 min before</option>
            <option value="10">10 min before</option>
            <option value="60">1 hour before</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
      <label class="f">Location <input id="f-loc" value="${esc(ev ? ev.location : "")}" placeholder="Meet · platform"></label>
      <label class="f">Also show in <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--faint)">(a task or event can live in several calendars)</span>
        <div class="calpick" id="f-also">
          ${editable.map(c => `<label class="${selIds.includes(c.id) ? "on" : ""}" style="--cc:${c.color}">
            <input type="checkbox" value="${c.id}" ${selIds.includes(c.id) ? "checked" : ""}>
            <i style="background:${c.color}"></i>${esc(c.name)}</label>`).join("")}
        </div>
      </label>
      <label class="f">Description <textarea id="f-desc">${esc(ev ? ev.description : "")}</textarea></label>
      <label class="f">Guests <input id="f-guests" value="${esc(ev ? (ev.guests||[]).join(", ") : "")}" placeholder="marta, jordi"></label>
      <div class="err" id="f-err"></div>
    </div>
    <footer>
      <button class="btn" data-act="close">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn primary" data-act="save">${isNew ? "Create" : "Save"}</button>
    </footer>`, () => {
      const rep = $("#f-rep");
      const preselect = (sel, val) => { if (val != null) sel.value = String(val); };
      if (ev && ev.reminders && ev.reminders.length){
        preselect($("#f-rem"), ev.reminders[0].minutes_before);
        if (ev.reminders[1]) preselect($("#f-rem2"), ev.reminders[1].minutes_before);
      } else if (ev){
        preselect($("#f-rem"), -1);
      }
      $("#f-also").querySelectorAll("input").forEach(inp => inp.onchange = () => {
        inp.closest("label").classList.toggle("on", inp.checked);
      });
      $("#f-allday").onchange = (e) => {
        if (e.target.checked){
          const s = $("#f-start").value.slice(0,10);
          $("#f-start").value = s + "T00:00";
          $("#f-end").value = s + "T23:59";
        }
      };
      document.querySelectorAll("#modal [data-act='close']").forEach(b => b.onclick = closeModal);
      $("#modal [data-act='save']").onclick = () => {
        const title = $("#f-title").value.trim();
        const err = $("#f-err");
        if (!title){ err.textContent = "A title is required."; return; }
        const ids = [...$("#f-also").querySelectorAll("input:checked")].map(i => i.value);
        const primaryId = $("#f-cal").value;
        const calendarIds = [...new Set([primaryId, ...ids])].filter(Boolean);
        if (!calendarIds.length){ err.textContent = "Pick at least one calendar."; return; }
        const startV = $("#f-start").value, endV = $("#f-end").value;
        if (!startV || !endV){ err.textContent = "Start and end are required."; return; }
        if (new Date(endV) <= new Date(startV)){ err.textContent = "The end must be after the start."; return; }

        const reminders = [];
        const r1 = parseInt($("#f-rem").value,10);
        if (r1 >= 0) reminders.push({ channel:"popup", minutes_before:r1 });
        const r2 = parseInt($("#f-rem2").value,10);
        if (r2 >= 0) reminders.push({ channel:"popup", minutes_before:r2 });

        let recurrence = null;
        const freq = rep.value;
        if (freq){
          const until = isoLocal(new Date(new Date(startV).getTime() + 120*DAY)).replace(/[-:]/g,"").slice(0,8);
          const byday = freq === "WEEKLY" ? ";BYDAY=" + ["MO","TU","WE","TH","FR","SA","SU"][(new Date(startV).getDay()+6)%7] : "";
          recurrence = { rrule:`FREQ=${freq};INTERVAL=1${byday};UNTIL:${until}T235959Z`.replace(";UNTIL:", ";UNTIL="), exdates:[], overrides:{} };
        }

        const payload = {
          title, calendar_ids:calendarIds, start:startV, end:endV,
          all_day: $("#f-allday").checked, location:$("#f-loc").value.trim(),
          description:$("#f-desc").value.trim(), guests: $("#f-guests").value.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
          reminders, recurrence, status:"confirmed", visibility:"default",
          source: ev ? ev.source : "native", refs: ev ? (ev.refs || {}) : {}
        };
        if (isNew){
          state.events.push(Object.assign({ id:"evt_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9),
            created_by:"alice", revision:1, created_at:new Date().toISOString() }, payload));
          pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"Event created", body:title });
        } else {
          Object.assign(ev, payload, { revision:(ev.revision||1)+1, updated_at:new Date().toISOString() });
          pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"Event updated", body:title });
        }
        closeModal(); save(); renderAll();
      };
    });
}

function openCalendarEditor(cal){
  const isNew = !cal;
  const colors = ["#CC0099","#4696DC","#3CB450","#FFB428","#F05050","#7C5CFF","#14B8A6","#8F008F"];
  openModal(`
    <header><h2>${isNew ? "New calendar" : "Edit calendar"}</h2>
      <button class="btn icon" data-act="close">✕</button></header>
    <div class="content">
      <label class="f">Name <input id="c-name" value="${esc(isNew ? "" : cal.name)}" placeholder="Work"></label>
      <label class="f">Colour
        <div class="swatches" id="c-swatches">
          ${colors.map(c => `<button data-color="${c}" class="${(!isNew && cal.color === c) || (isNew && c === colors[0]) ? "on" : ""}"
            style="background:${c}" aria-label="colour ${c}"></button>`).join("")}
        </div>
      </label>
      <label class="f">Default reminder
        <select id="c-rem">
          <option value="-1">None</option>
          <option value="0">At start</option>
          <option value="5">5 min before</option>
          <option value="10">10 min before</option>
          <option value="30">30 min before</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="checkbox"><input type="checkbox" id="c-visible" ${isNew || cal.visible ? "checked" : ""}> Visible</label>
      <div class="err" id="c-err"></div>
    </div>
    <footer>
      ${isNew ? "" : '<button class="btn danger" data-act="del" style="margin-right:auto">Delete calendar</button>'}
      <button class="btn" data-act="close">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn primary" data-act="save">${isNew ? "Create" : "Save"}</button>
    </footer>`, () => {
    let color = isNew ? colors[0] : cal.color;
    if (!isNew){
      const def = (cal.default_reminders && cal.default_reminders[0]) ? cal.default_reminders[0].minutes_before : -1;
      $("#c-rem").value = String(def);
    }
    $("#c-swatches").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      color = b.dataset.color;
      $("#c-swatches").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("on"));
      b.classList.add("on");
    });
    document.querySelectorAll("#modal [data-act='close']").forEach(b => b.onclick = closeModal);
    const del = $("#modal [data-act='del']");
    if (del) del.onclick = () => {
      const used = state.events.some(e => e.calendar_ids.includes(cal.id));
      if (used){ $("#c-err").textContent = "This calendar still has events. Move or delete them first (409 calendar_in_use)."; return; }
      state.calendars = state.calendars.filter(c => c.id !== cal.id);
      closeModal(); save(); renderAll();
    };
    $("#modal [data-act='save']").onclick = () => {
      const name = $("#c-name").value.trim();
      if (!name){ $("#c-err").textContent = "A name is required."; return; }
      const rem = parseInt($("#c-rem").value,10);
      const visible = $("#c-visible").checked;
      const defaults = rem >= 0 ? [{ channel:"popup", minutes_before:rem }] : [];
      if (isNew){
        state.calendars.push({ id:"cal_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8), name, color,
          kind:"personal", read_only:false, visible, default_reminders:defaults });
        pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"Calendar created", body:name });
      } else {
        Object.assign(cal, { name, color, visible, default_reminders:defaults });
      }
      closeModal(); save(); renderAll();
    };
  });
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. clock, now-line, navigation
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function updateClock(){
  const d = new Date(state.now);
  $("#sim-clock").textContent = `${pad2(d.getHours())}:${pad2(d.getMinutes())}`;
  const play = $("#sim-play");
  play.textContent = state.speed === 0 ? "▶" : "❚❚";
}
function updateNowLine(){
  const now = new Date(state.now);
  document.querySelectorAll(".nowline").forEach(n => {
    const isToday = n.dataset.now === dateKey(now);
    n.hidden = !isToday;
    if (!isToday) return;
    const minutes = now.getHours()*60 + now.getMinutes();
    n.style.top = (minutes/60*44) + "px";
  });
}
function tick(){
  if (state.speed > 0){
    state.now += 1000 * state.speed;
    checkReminders(60*1000);
  }
  updateClock(); updateNowLine();
}
function nextReminder(){
  const now = state.now;
  const occs = occurrencesBetween(new Date(now - HOUR), new Date(now + 14*DAY), { includeHidden:true });
  let best = null;
  for (const occ of occs){
    for (const r of remindersOf(occ.event, occ)){
      const key = `${occ.event.id}|${isoLocal(occ.start)}|${r.minutes_before}`;
      if (state.delivered[key]) continue;
      const trig = occ.start.getTime() - (r.minutes_before||0)*MIN;
      if (trig > now && (!best || trig < best)) best = trig;
    }
  }
  if (best == null){
    pushNotification({ kind:"system", title:"No upcoming reminders",
      body:"Add a reminder to an event in the next 14 days." });
    return;
  }
  state.now = best;
  checkReminders(0);
  updateClock(); updateNowLine();
}

function navigate(dir){
  if (state.view === "month") state.cursor = addMonths(state.cursor, dir);
  else if (state.view === "week") state.cursor = addDays(state.cursor, 7*dir);
  else state.cursor = addDays(state.cursor, dir === 0 ? 0 : dir);
  renderAll();
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. wiring
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function init(){
  load();
  renderAll();
  updateClock();

  $("#btn-today").onclick = () => { state.cursor = startOfDay(new Date()); renderAll(); };
  $("#btn-prev").onclick = () => navigate(-1);
  $("#btn-next").onclick = () => navigate(1);
  $("#btn-new").onclick = () => openEventEditor(null);
  $("#btn-create").onclick = () => openEventEditor(null);
  $("#btn-add-cal").onclick = () => openCalendarEditor(null);
  $("#btn-bell").onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleNotif(); };
  $("#sim-play").onclick = () => { state.speed = state.speed === 0 ? 60 : 0; updateClock(); };
  $("#sim-next").onclick = nextReminder;
  $("#sim-reset").onclick = () => { state.now = Date.now(); updateClock(); updateNowLine(); };
  $("#btn-reset").onclick = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORE_KEY);
    const fresh = seed();
    state.calendars = fresh.calendars; state.events = fresh.events;
    state.notifications = fresh.notifications; state.delivered = {}; state.snoozes = {};
    state.cursor = startOfDay(new Date()); state.now = Date.now();
    save(); renderAll(); updateClock();
  };
  document.querySelectorAll("#view-switch button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
    state.view = b.dataset.view; renderAll();
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (!e.target.closest("#notif-panel") && !e.target.closest("#btn-bell")) toggleNotif(false);
    if (!e.target.closest("#detail")) closeDetail();
  });
  $("#backdrop").addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target.id === "backdrop") closeModal(); });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.target.matches("input,textarea,select")) return;
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === "escape"){ closeModal(); closeDetail(); toggleNotif(false); }
    else if (k === "n"){ e.preventDefault(); openEventEditor(null); }
    else if (k === "t"){ state.cursor = startOfDay(new Date()); renderAll(); }
    else if (k === "m"){ state.view = "month"; renderAll(); }
    else if (k === "w"){ state.view = "week"; renderAll(); }
    else if (k === "d"){ state.view = "day"; renderAll(); }
    else if (k === "a"){ state.view = "agenda"; renderAll(); }
    else if (k === "arrowleft"){ navigate(-1); }
    else if (k === "arrowright"){ navigate(1); }
  });

  // catch up on reminders that fired while the prototype was closed (analysis §7.2)
  checkReminders(6*HOUR);
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
  updateNowLine();
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

# Calendar manager — interactive prototype

Open **`index.html`** in any browser (`file://` works, no server, no build, no network).
Everything is demo data kept in `localStorage`; the sidebar has *Reset demo data*.

> This is a **UX prototype**, not the implementation. It exists to agree on the
> interaction model before code is written. The design it visualises is
> `../01-analysis.md`.

## What to try (5 minutes)

1. **Multiple calendars** — untick *Work* in the sidebar: its chips disappear
   everywhere. Click a calendar name to rename it or change its colour.
2. **A task in two calendars** — find the chip **“Sprint 42 review”**: it carries a
   two-tone bar (orange `codx-junior` + magenta `Work`) and two dots. That is the
   multi-calendar membership of one single task, not two events.
3. **Read-only projection** — open a chip on the orange calendar (“Fix onboarding
   copy”, “Run: autonomous-profiles”, “Daily standup”). The popover says
   *read-only* and offers **Open task** instead of **Edit/Delete**. That is the
   `codx-junior` system calendar of analysis §6.
4. **Reminders** — the *Spec review* event starts ~9 minutes from now with a
   15-minute reminder, so a popup fires on the first load (catch-up behaviour,
   §7.2). After that, use **⏭ next** in the top bar to jump the simulated clock to
   the next pending reminder. `❚❚` pauses the clock (it runs at 60× by default).
5. **Notification centre** — the bell keeps a persistent, read/unread list with
   *All / Reminders / System* tabs. Snooze a popup: it re-fires 5 simulated
   minutes later and leaves an entry in the centre.
6. **Views** — Month, Week, Day, Agenda. In Week/Day click an empty slot to create
   an event at that hour; the red line is the simulated “now”.
7. **Recurrence** — *Daily standup* (Mon–Fri) and *Team retro* (monthly) are
   expanded on the fly; open either to see the RRULE in the detail popover.
8. **Create** — `+ New event`, pick a second calendar under **“Also show in”**, add
   two reminders, and check the multi-colour chip that results.

Keys: `n` new · `t` today · `m` `w` `d` `a` views · `←` `→` navigate · `Esc` close.

## Deliberate simplifications (documented, not bugs)

| Prototype | Production design |
| --- | --- |
| Naive **local** ISO strings (`2026-02-10T09:00`) | UTC ISO + the calendar's timezone; the server returns occurrences (§8) |
| Recurrence expanded in the browser, `UNTIL` honoured, `COUNT` parsed but ignored | Expanded server-side, `COUNT` + `UNTIL` + per-instance `overrides`, capped at 750 instances / 2 years |
| No timezone selector | Per-calendar timezone, `Intl.DateTimeFormat` for display |
| Data in `localStorage` | `<codx_path>/calendar/*.json`, atomic writes, `flock` (§4) |
| Reminder tick is a browser interval | Background thread + socket broadcast + `delivered.json` dedupe (§7) |
| Single user, no ACL | `members[{user, role}]`, `visibility: private` (§11) |
| No drag-to-move / resize handles wired | Drag & resize call the planning API for tasks and `PUT /events` for events (§9.3) |
| No ICS/Google panel | Milestones M3/M4 (§10) |

## Files

```
design/06-calendar/
├── 01-analysis.md                  # the deep analysis (read this first)
├── 02-prototype/
│   ├── index.html                  # the prototype (self-contained)
│   └── README.md                   # this file
└── 03-fixtures/
    └── calendar-fixture.json       # the same dataset, in the API's shape
```

`03-fixtures/calendar-fixture.json` is the canonical dataset: it is what the
prototype should keep showing, and what the backend tests (`api/tests/test_calendar_*.py`)
will load. If a change makes the prototype and the fixture disagree, the fixture
is right.

# Calendar manager — interactive prototype

Open **`index.html`** in any browser (`file://` works, no server, no build, no network).
Everything is demo data kept in `localStorage`; the sidebar has *Reset demo data*.

> This is a **UX prototype**, not the implementation. It exists to agree on the
> interaction model before code is written. The design it visualises is
> `../01-analysis.md`.

## What to try (5 minutes)

1. **Multiple calendars** — untick *Work* in the sidebar: its chips disappear
   everywhere. Click a calendar name to rename it or change its colour.
2. **A task in two calendars** — find the chip **“Sprint 42 review”**: it carries a
   two-tone bar (orange `codx-junior` + magenta `Work`) and two dots. That is the
   multi-calendar membership of one single task, not two events.
3. **Read-only projection** — open a chip on the orange calendar (“Fix onboarding
   copy”, “Run: autonomous-profiles”, “Daily standup”). The popover says
   *read-only* and offers **Open task** instead of **Edit/Delete**. That is the
   `codx-junior` system calendar of analysis §6.
4. **Reminders** — the *Spec review* event starts ~9 minutes from now with a
   15-minute reminder, so exactly one popup fires on the first load (catch-up
   behaviour, §7.2). The *Daily standup* reminder is hours old, so it lands in the
   notification centre flagged **missed** and does **not** pop: the popup is for
   the present, the centre is the record. After that, use **⏭ next** in the top bar
   to jump the simulated clock to the next pending reminder. `❚❚` pauses the clock
   (it runs at 60× by default).
5. **Notification centre** — the bell keeps a persistent, read/unread list with
   *All / Reminders / System* tabs. Snooze a popup: it re-fires 5 simulated
   minutes later and leaves an entry in the centre.
6. **Views** — Month, Week, Day, Agenda. In Week/Day click an empty slot to create
   an event at that hour; the red line is the simulated “now”.
7. **Recurrence** — *Daily standup* (Mon–Fri) and *Team retro* (monthly) are
   expanded on the fly; open either to see the RRULE in the detail popover.
8. **Create** — `+ New event`, pick a second calendar under **“Also show in”**, add
   two reminders, and check the multi-colour chip that results.

Keys: `n` new · `t` today · `m` `w` `d` `a` views · `←` `→` navigate · `Esc` close.

## Deliberate simplifications (documented, not bugs)

| Prototype | Production design |
| --- | --- |
| Naive **local** ISO strings (`2026-02-10T09:00`) | UTC ISO + the calendar's timezone; the server returns occurrences (§8) |
| Recurrence expanded in the browser, `UNTIL` honoured, `COUNT` parsed but ignored, `overrides` NOT applied | Expanded server-side, `COUNT` + `UNTIL` + per-instance `overrides`, capped at 750 instances / 2 years |
| No timezone selector | Per-calendar timezone, `Intl.DateTimeFormat` for display |
| Data in `localStorage` | `<codx_path>/calendar/*.json`, atomic writes, `flock` (§4) |
| Reminder tick is a browser interval | Background thread + socket broadcast + `delivered.json` dedupe (§7) |
| Single user, no ACL | `members[{user, role}]`, `visibility: private` (§11) |
| No drag-to-move / resize handles wired | Drag & resize call the planning API for tasks and `PUT /events` for events (§9.3) |
| No ICS/Google panel | Milestones M3/M4 (§10) |

The prototype was checked in a real browser: recurrence expansion reproduces the
fixture (`5` standups Mon–Fri, `1` spec review, `1` 1:1, `1` retro = `8` native
occurrences for the window `2026-02-09 → 2026-02-16`, with the offsite and the
flight correctly excluded), one popup on load with the older reminder flagged
*missed*, multi-calendar chips, calendar toggling, event creation with two
calendars and a reminder, and the notification centre tabs.

will load. If a change makes the prototype and the fixture disagree, the fixture
is right.

# codx-junior — Design Documentation

Corporate image and UI/UX foundation for **codx-junior**, derived from an audit of the
shipping product (`client/` — project `codx-junior-ui`).

> **Status:** v0.1 — *baseline definition*. Everything here describes either
> (a) what the product does **today**, verified in code, or (b) a **decision
> proposal** to close a gap. Each statement is labelled so the two never get
> confused.

> **Start here — [`playbook/index.html`](playbook/index.html).** The whole design system on
> one self-contained page: live component specimens, dark/light toggle, print-ready layout.
> Hand it to any developer before they write UI code.

---

## Why this folder exists

codx-junior grew feature-first: 400+ Vue components, several parallel shells
(desktop dockview, mobile app shell, company shell, solopreneur shell) and three
different colour palettes that leaked into the codebase over time. The product
works, but it does not yet look like *one company*.

This folder is the single place where the corporate image is defined, so that:

- a new screen can be designed without inventing new colours, spacing or copy;
- a designer and a developer can agree on a spec without a meeting;
- rebrand work (logo, palette, marketing site) has a contract to break *on purpose*.

---

## How to read it

| Folder | Contents | Audience |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playbook/` | **The playbook** (`index.html`) — this whole folder on one page, with rendered specimens | Developers, new joiners |
| `resources/` | **Official artwork** — `logo.png` (the mark, 267 × 266 PNG + alpha) and `me-and-codx-junior.png` (brand photograph). Embedded by the playbook, taken from here, never re-exported | Everyone |
| `00-audit/` | What the current UI actually is, with file-level evidence | Designers, tech leads |
| `01-brand/` | Brand platform, logo, colour, typography, voice — the *corporate image* | Everyone, marketing included |
| `02-design-system/` | Foundations (space, radius, motion, layering) and component specs | Designers, frontend |
| `03-ux/` | Information architecture, navigation model, accessibility | Designers, PMs, frontend |
| `04-assets/` | Asset production rules: formats, sizes, naming, export | Design, marketing |
| `05-governance/` | Ownership, versioning, review checklist, adoption roadmap | Leads |
| `tokens/` | `design-tokens.json` — machine-readable source for the values above | Frontend |

Reading order for a newcomer: **audit → brand platform → colour → typography →
foundations → components → IA**.

---

## Ground rules

1. **The code is the current truth; this folder is the target truth.** When they
   disagree, the documents say which one wins.
2. **No new colour, radius or spacing value without a token.** If a value is
   missing, add a token here first, then use it.
3. **Every doc is versioned with the product**, not separately. See

> Status: **design + prototype only. No application code has been changed.**
> Scope: a Google-Calendar-style agenda in codx-junior — multiple calendars, a
> system `codx-junior` calendar fed by scheduled tasks, a notification centre

recurrence engine reproduces the fixture's expected occurrences (5 standups in
the anchor week, the offsite and the flight correctly outside the window), one

## 0. TL;DR — the decision

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Where does the data live? | `<codx_path>/calendar/` — JSON documents written atomically, same conventions as `orchestration/runs/*.json`. **Not** inside the chat/board documents. |
| How many calendars? | Unlimited per project, like Google. Each has a colour, timezone, default reminders and ACL. |
| How does a task appear in several calendars? | The **item** owns the list of calendars (`calendar_ids[]`), not the calendar. A task is *always* in the system calendar `codx-junior` and *optionally* pinned to N user calendars. |
| What is the `codx-junior` calendar? | A **virtual, read-only system calendar** whose items are projections of task data (`Chat.due_date` / new `scheduled_start`/`scheduled_end`). It cannot hold hand-made events; it is computed on read. |
| Who expands recurrences and timezones? | The **server** returns *occurrences*, not events (precedent: `planning_manager.py` already derives flags/counts server-side). The client only renders. |
| How do reminders fire? | A background thread in `background.py` ticks every 30 s, dedupes through a persisted `delivered.json`, and emits a socket event. The client turns it into a toast + entry in the notification centre. |
| Google Calendar? | Phased: **ICS export/import** first, **read-only Google import** second, **two-way sync** last (highest risk, see §10). |
| Effort | ~4 milestones, §16. M0 (read + tasks + reminders) is the useful 60 %. |

## 1. Request, restated as requirements

| id | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| R1 | Visualise events and planning in an agenda (day / week / month / agenda list). |
| R2 | Create **multiple calendars** with own colour/visibility (Google Calendar behaviour). |
| R3 | **Notifications section** (a centre, not just a transient toast). |
| R4 | **Popup reminders** before an event starts. |
| R5 | A **`codx-junior` calendar** showing scheduled tasks, meets and orchestration runs. |
| R6 | A **task can belong to several calendars**. |
| R7 | Create, edit, move, resize, delete events; all-day and multi-day events. |
| R8 | Recurring events. |
| R9 | Guests/attendees on an event (at minimum a link to a project user). |
| R10 | Follow Google Calendar interaction conventions so no training is needed. |
| R11 | Must not break the existing Task Manager, Planning view or Meet scheduling. |
| R12 | Deep analysis + prototype **before** any change (this document + prototype). |

## 2. What already exists (evidence)

Everything below was read in the current tree. This is what we reuse versus what
we must build.

### 2.1 Reusable

| Piece | File | How the calendar uses it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task fields | `api/codx/junior/db.py` → `Chat` | `due_date`, `priority`, `status`, `assignees`, `sprints`, `run_id`, `run_status`. Persisted through the existing `/api/chats/metadata` endpoint (it `setattr`s declared fields), so **new fields need no migration**. |
| Server-side derivation | `api/codx/junior/planning_manager.py` | Already computes `overdue / due_today / days_until_due` and server-side sorting. The calendar's occurrence expansion follows the same "server derives, client renders" rule. |
| File storage | `api/codx/junior/orchestration/store.py` | The exact pattern to copy: one JSON document per entity, `NamedTemporaryFile` + `fsync` + `os.replace`, `flock` for cross-process exclusion. |
| Router registration | `api/codx/junior/api/__init__.py` → `discover_routers()` | Any new `api/calendar.py` exporting `router` is mounted automatically at `/api`. No `app.py` edit needed. |
| Background loops | `api/codx/junior/background.py` → `start_background_services()` | Where the reminder ticker is added (a daemon thread next to `check_projects`). |
| Socket broadcast | `api/codx/junior/sio/session_channel.py`, `events/event_manager.py` | `EventManager.send_notification(**kwargs)` and `channel.send_event(name, payload)` (no `sid` = broadcast). |
| Cross-client invalidation | `api/codx/junior/events/collection_events.py` | Add `calendars` / `calendar_events` to `COLLECTIONS` so every open tab reloads. |
| Notification store | `client/src/store/ui.js` → `notifications[]`, `addNotification` | The existing 30 s auto-expiring toast list. R4 needs a **persistent** centre next to it, not a replacement. |
| Notification UI | `client/src/components/Notifications.vue`, `NotificationControl.vue`, `EventBar.vue` | The bell already exists in the top bar and already merges "recent events" + typed notifications. Extend it with a calendar section instead of inventing a second bell. |
| App/route registry | `client/src/config/apps.js`, `appComponentsMap.js`, `router/index.ts` | One registry entry + one route + one lazy component = the screen is reachable from the sidebar, dockview and mobile. |
| API modules | `client/src/api/api.js` + `client/src/api/modules/*.js` | `calendarModule(API)` registered with the lazy `API._calendarModule` getter. |
| Vuex modules | `client/src/store/index.js` | `import * as calendar from './calendar'` and it is `init()`-ed automatically. |
| Meets | `api/codx/junior/meets/*`, `api/codx/junior/api/meets.py` | A meet is a *live* room; the calendar shows future/held meets as items with `refs.meet_id`. **`MeetManager` is in-memory only** — calendar events must therefore be the durable record of a scheduled meet. |
| Orchestration runs | `api/codx/junior/orchestration/*` | `run_id`, `run_status`, `created_at` give the "scheduled work" items for the `codx-junior` calendar. |
| Design tokens | `design/tokens/design-tokens.json` | Colours for calendars (brand magenta + the existing `chartSeries` palette). |

### 2.2 Gaps — what does not exist

| Gap | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| No calendar storage | Nothing under `.codx/` holds events. `client/src/components/solopreneur/SolopreneurCalendar.vue` is a **static mock** (`useSolopreneur.js` state, grouped list, no dates). |
| `due_date` is a *date*, not a slot | `Chat.due_date` is `YYYY-MM-DD`. There is no start/end datetime, no duration, no all-day flag → a task cannot be laid out on an hour grid. |
| One calendar per task, implicitly | Tasks have `sprints[]` and `board/column`, but no `calendar_ids[]`. |
| No recurrence engine | No RRULE anywhere; `python-dateutil` is **not** in `api/pyproject.toml` dependencies (verified) and the client only has `moment` (no `moment-timezone`, no `rrule`). |
| No reminder scheduler | Nothing computes "notify N minutes before X". `EventManager.send_notification` is push-only, with no scheduling or dedupe. |
| Notifications are ephemeral | `ui.addNotification` removes the entry after 30 s and keeps it in memory only → a missed reminder is lost forever. |
| No notification centre | `Notifications.vue` shows the last 3 items of a rolling list; there is no unread state, no "mark as read", no persistence. |
| No ICS / Google layer | Nothing. The only OAuth implementation is GitHub (`security/github_oauth.py`). |
| Meet has no schedule | `Meet` has `created_at`/`ended_at` only; a "meet at 15:00 tomorrow" cannot be represented. |

## 3. Domain model

Four entities. `Calendar` and `CalendarEvent` are stored; `Occurrence` and
`Reminder` are derived.

```mermaid

    EVENT ||--o{ EVENT_CALENDAR : "appears in"
    EVENT ||--o{ REMINDER : "schedules"
    EVENT ||--o{ OCCURRENCE : "expands to"
    CHAT ||--o{ OCCURRENCE : "projects into (source=task)"
    MEET ||--o{ OCCURRENCE : "projects into (source=meet)"

    CALENDAR {
        string id PK
        string name
        string color

        bool read_only

        bool visible
    }
    EVENT {
        string id PK
        string title
        string start "UTC ISO"
        string end "UTC ISO"
        bool all_day
        json recurrence "RRULE + exdates + overrides"
        json reminders
        string source "native|task|meet|orchestration|external"
        json refs "chat_id|meet_id|run_id"
        int revision
    }
    EVENT_CALENDAR {
        string event_id FK
        string calendar_id FK
    }
    OCCURRENCE {

```

### 3.1 Calendar

```json
{
  "id": "cal_work",
  "name": "Work",
  "color": "#CC0099",
  "description": "",
  "kind": "personal",
  "timezone": "Europe/Madrid",
  "read_only": false,
  "provider": "local",
  "default_reminders": [{ "channel": "popup", "minutes_before": 10 }],
  "members": [{ "user": "alice", "role": "owner" }],
  "visible": true,
  "order": 0,
  "created_at": "2026-02-01T09:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-02-01T09:00:00Z"
}
```

`kind` drives behaviour:

| kind | writable | Origin | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `personal` | yes | created by a user | "Work", "Personal" |
| `team` | yes (members) | one per project team | "Team — Platform" |
| `project` | yes | one per project, auto-created | "acme — delivery" |
| `system` | **no** | generated | `codx-junior` (tasks/meets/runs) |
| `external` | no | imported | "Holidays (ICS)", Google calendars |

### 3.2 CalendarEvent

```json
{
  "id": "evt_01JQ8Z…",
  "calendar_ids": ["cal_work", "cal_personal"],
  "title": "Spec review — calendar manager",
  "description": "Walk through §4 storage + §7 reminders.",
  "location": "Meet /meet/9f2a",
  "start": "2026-02-10T09:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-02-10T10:00:00Z",
  "all_day": false,
  "timezone": "Europe/Madrid",
  "recurrence": null,
  "reminders": [
    { "channel": "popup", "minutes_before": 15 },
    { "channel": "popup", "minutes_before": 0 }
  ],
  "status": "confirmed",
  "visibility": "default",
  "source": "native",
  "refs": {},
  "guests": ["marta"],
  "created_by": "alice",
  "created_at": "2026-02-03T10:12:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-02-03T10:12:00Z",
  "revision": 1
}
```

**Invariants**

1. `calendar_ids` is non-empty, deduplicated, and every id must resolve to an
   existing calendar (validated on write; a dangling id is returned by
   `GET /calendars?orphans=1` for repair, never silently dropped).
2. A `system` or `external` calendar can never appear alone in
   `calendar_ids` in a *write*: content coming from a projection cannot be
   edited (409 `read_only_calendar`).
3. `end > start` unless `all_day` (then `end = start + 1 day` inclusive-exclusive).
4. `revision` is incremented on every write; clients send `If-Match` (§5.3).
5. A recurring event stores the **first** `start`; instances are computed.
6. A recurring event **cannot span calendars differently per instance** (a
   Google limitation we intentionally keep: it removes a whole class of bugs).

### 3.3 Occurrence (derived, never stored)

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01JQ8Z…",
  "calendar_ids": ["cal_work", "cal_personal"],
  "title": "Spec review — calendar manager",
  "start": "2026-02-10T09:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-02-10T10:00:00Z",
  "all_day": false,
  "source": "native",
  "refs": {},
  "calendar_id": "cal_work",
  "is_recurring_instance": false,
  "original_start": null,
  "overdue": false,
  "read_only": false
}
```

`calendar_id` (singular) is the calendar whose colour the chip uses; the full
`calendar_ids` list is what the UI shows as multi-calendar badges. This is the
key to R6: **one occurrence, N memberships.**

### 3.4 Reminder (derived)

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01JQ8Z…",
  "occurrence_start": "2026-02-10T09:00:00Z",
  "minutes_before": 15,
  "channel": "popup",
  "trigger_at": "2026-02-10T08:45:00Z",
  "delivered_at": null
}
```

---

## 4. Storage design

### 4.1 Layout

```
<codx_path>/calendar/
├── calendars.json                 # [Calendar]  — small, single document
├── events/
│   ├── 2026-01.json               # [CalendarEvent] keyed by start month (UTC)
│   ├── 2026-02.json
│   └── 2026-03.json
├── delivered.json                 # reminder dedupe (see §7.3)
├── settings.json                  # window prefs, default calendar, week start
└── export/
    └── cal_work.ics               # generated feed (git-ignored)
```

### 4.2 Why not store this on the Chat / board document?

- A board document is rewritten wholesale on every card move; adding events
  there would multiply write amplification and lock contention.
- Events are **not** tasks: they have guests, recurrence and reminders, and they
  must be queryable by date range across the whole project.
- Tasks only ever *project* into the calendar. Keeping the projection read-only
  guarantees that the Task Manager stays the single writer of task data.

### 4.3 Conventions copied from `orchestration/store.py`

- **Atomic write**: temp file in the same directory → `flush` → `fsync` →
  `os.replace`. A crash can never leave half a month file.
- **Cross-process exclusion**: `fcntl.flock` on `calendar/.lock` while a write is
  in flight (the API runs several uvicorn workers — see the comment in
  `pyproject.toml` about multi-worker deployments, the same hazard applies here).
- **Bounded, validated ids**: `os.path.basename()` on every id before building a
  path, exactly like `RunStore.run_path`.
- **Tolerant reads**: a corrupt month file is logged and skipped; the calendar
  still renders (never a 500 because of one bad file).

### 4.4 Month sharding and the overlap problem

Query windows are small by nature (month view = 3 shards, week = 2, agenda = 2).
A long event (holiday, offsite) may start before the window and overlap into it.
Rule:

> An event is stored in the shard of its **start** month, and a range query reads
> `[from - MAX_EVENT_DURATION, to]` where `MAX_EVENT_DURATION = 31 days`.
> Events longer than 31 days are rejected on write (400 `event_too_long`); a
> "long" period must be a recurring event or an all-day per-day block.

This keeps every query at ≤ 4 file reads with no index to maintain. If a project
ever exceeds ~20 k events, add `events/index.json` (`{id, month, start, end,
calendar_ids}`) — that is the documented escape hatch, not part of M0.

### 4.5 Size budget

| Item | Estimate |
| --- | --- |
| Calendar | ~400 B |
| Event (with description) | ~1 KB |
| 2 000 events / year / project | ≈ 2 MB total, ≈ 170 KB per shard |

Comfortably JSON. No database, no migration of existing data.

---

## 5. Backend API (contract)

All routes live in a new `api/codx/junior/api/calendar.py` exporting `router`
(auto-discovered, mounted at `/api`). Project scope comes from
`request.state.codx_junior_session.settings`, like `meets.py` and `management.py`.

### 5.1 Calendars

| Method | Path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/calendar/calendars` | Includes materialised `system` + `external` entries. |
| `POST` | `/api/calendar/calendars` | `{name, color, kind?, timezone?, default_reminders?}` → 201. |
| `PUT` | `/api/calendar/calendars/{id}` | Partial update (name, color, visible, order, reminders). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/calendar/calendars/{id}?move_to={other}` | 409 if it still has events and `move_to` was not given. A `system` calendar returns 409 `read_only_calendar`. |

### 5.2 Events and occurrences

| Method | Path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/api/calendar/events/query` | **The main read**: `{calendar_ids?, from, to, q?, sources?, include_hidden?}` → `{range, calendars, occurrences[], counts}`. Recurrences are expanded server-side. |
| `GET` | `/api/calendar/events/{id}` | Raw event (for the editor, which needs the rule, not the instances). |
| `POST` | `/api/calendar/events` | Create. `calendar_ids[]` required. |
| `PUT` | `/api/calendar/events/{id}` | Update. `If-Match: <revision>`; 409 `revision_mismatch` otherwise. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/calendar/events/{id}?scope=single\|following\|all` | Recurring delete semantics, same three options as Google. |
| `POST` | `/api/calendar/events/{id}/snooze` | `{minutes, occurrence_start}` → reschedules the reminder. |
| `POST` | `/api/calendar/events/quick` | `{text}` → parsed draft (`"Lunch Ana tom 13:00 1h @Café"`), **not persisted** until confirmed. |

Why a `POST /query` instead of `GET /events?from=…`: the request carries arrays
(calendar ids, sources) and grows; `POST` matches the existing
`POST /api/management/tasks/query` and `POST /api/planning/*` convention.

**Response sketch**

```json
{
  "range": { "from": "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z", "to": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", "timezone": "Europe/Madrid" },
  "calendars": [{ "id": "cal_work", "name": "Work", "color": "#CC0099", "read_only": false }],
  "occurrences": [ /* §3.3 */ ],
  "counts": { "by_calendar": { "cal_work": 12 }, "by_source": { "task": 5, "native": 7 } }
}
```

### 5.3 Concurrency, errors and events

- Optimistic locking with `revision` + `If-Match`. Two tabs editing the same
  event: the loser gets `409 revision_mismatch` with the current document so the
  UI can show a diff, instead of silently overwriting.
- Error codes (string `detail` prefix, consistent with `HTTPException` usage
  across the API): `read_only_calendar`, `revision_mismatch`, `event_too_long`,
  `invalid_recurrence`, `unknown_calendar`, `calendar_in_use`.
- After every successful write:
  `emit_collection_event(COLLECTION_CALENDAR_EVENTS, action, {id, calendar_ids}, settings=…)`
  → every open tab reloads only the affected range (new entries added to
  `COLLECTIONS` in `collection_events.py`).

### 5.4 Task → calendar fields

Extend `Chat` (`api/codx/junior/db.py`). All have defaults, so old task files load
unchanged and the existing `POST /api/chats/metadata` path persists them with no
new endpoint:

```python
calendar_ids: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
    description="Calendars this task is pinned to, beyond the implicit 'codx-junior' one")
scheduled_start: Optional[str] = None   # ISO datetime, the time block
scheduled_end:   Optional[str] = None   # ISO datetime
all_day: bool = False
```

`due_date` stays a **date** and keeps its meaning (deadline) — the calendar draws
it as an all-day marker with a deadline flag, while `scheduled_start/end` is the
work block. Conflating them would break the overdue logic in
`planning_manager.py`, which is tested and consumed by the Planning view.

---

## 6. The `codx-junior` calendar (R5 + R6)

A virtual calendar, present in every project, **read-only**. Its items are
projected from data we already own:

| Source | Rule | Badge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task with `scheduled_start/end` | Block at that time. | `Task` |
| Task with `due_date`, no schedule | All-day marker on the due date; `overdue` styling if `due < today` and `status != done`. | `Due` |
| Orchestration run (`run_id`, `run_status`) | Block from `started_at`, or all-day if not started. | `Run` |
| Meet | Block at the scheduled time (needs the new `Meet.scheduled_start`, §11). | `Meet` |

Properties:

- **Not writable.** Dragging a `codx-junior` item moves the *task* (calls
  `PUT /api/planning/tasks/{id}`-equivalent), not an event. This is the behaviour
  that makes the calendar useful instead of a second task board.
- **Filterable** by source, board, sprint, assignee, status
  (the query's `sources` + `boards` fields), reusing the planning filters.
- **Multi-calendar**: a task shows *simultaneously* in `codx-junior` and in any
  calendar in its `calendar_ids`. Adding it to "Work" does not duplicate it; it
  is one task with two memberships, so completing it clears both.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    T[Chat / task<br/>scheduled_start, due_date, calendar_ids=['cal_work']]
    T --> P[Projection]
    P --> SYS[codx-junior calendar<br/>system, read-only]
    P --> W[Work calendar<br/>via calendar_ids]
    W -->|drag / resize| API[PUT /api/planning/tasks/:id]
    SYS -->|drag / resize| API
```

## 7. Notifications and popup reminders (R3 + R4)

### 7.1 Pipeline

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant BG as Background thread (30 s)
    participant ST as calendar store
    participant SIO as Socket.IO (broadcast)
    participant CL as Client store/calendar.js
    participant UI as NotificationCentre + popup

    BG->>ST: load events in [now-1d, now+7d]
    BG->>BG: expand occurrences, compute trigger_at = start - minutes
    BG->>ST: read delivered.json
    BG->>BG: due = trigger_at <= now and not delivered
    BG->>ST: append to delivered.json (atomic)
    BG->>SIO: emit codx-junior-calendar-reminder {occurrence, minutes_before}
    SIO->>CL: event
    CL->>UI: push notification + show popup card
    UI->>ST: POST /events/{id}/snooze  (optional)
```

### 7.2 Why a background thread and not "the browser sets a timeout"

The browser timer is the easy path and it is wrong: it dies with the tab, it
cannot deliver when the app is closed, and a laptop asleep at 09:45 never fires
the 10:00 reminder. The server tick also makes email/Web-Push a later plug-in
instead of a rewrite.

It still degrades gracefully: if the tick runs while nobody is connected, the
reminder is **marked delivered and persisted**, so the notification centre shows
it as "missed" the next time the client loads (`GET /api/calendar/reminders?since=`).

### 7.3 Delivery dedupe

`delivered.json`:

```json
{ "evt_01JQ8Z…|2026-02-10T09:00:00Z|15": "2026-02-10T08:45:03Z" }
```

Key = `event_id|occurrence_start|minutes_before`. Bounded: entries older than 30
days are pruned on every tick (≈ 3 events/day → a few hundred lines). Exactly the
same trick as the harness `notification_sent` flag (see
`api/tests/harness/test_harness_notification.py`: "must be sent exactly once …
the durable flag survives duplicate ticks/restarts").

### 7.4 Client side

- `store/calendar.js` (new Vuex module) holds `calendars`, `occurrences`,
  `notifications[]` (**persistent**, unlike `ui.notifications`), `unreadCount`.
- Socket handler registered once at `init()`:
  `API.socket.on('codx-junior-calendar-reminder', …)` (the `SocketManager.on`
  keeps named listeners across reconnects — verified in `api/socket.js`).
- `components/calendar/ReminderPopup.vue` — bottom-right card: title, time,
  "Snooze 5 / 10 min", "Dismiss", "Open". Auto-dismiss after 60 s **without**
  losing the notification-centre entry.
- `components/Notifications.vue` gains a third section ("Reminders") plus
  unread/read state. The transient `ui.addNotification` toasts stay for
  operational messages (they are not a reminder channel).
- Browser `Notification` API: **opt-in** toggle in the calendar settings, used
  only when the tab is backgrounded. Requires HTTPS/localhost.
- M3 extension: Web Push (service worker + VAPID) and email; both plug into the
  same tick, which is why the design keeps delivery out of the request path.

## 8. Recurrence and timezones

### 8.1 Model

Store **RFC 5545 RRULE** as a string, plus exceptions — the same shape Google
Calendar and ICS use, so export is lossless:

```json
"recurrence": {
  "rrule": "FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=MO,WE;UNTIL=20260630T000000Z",
  "exdates": ["2026-03-04T09:00:00Z"],
  "overrides": {
    "2026-03-11T09:00:00Z": { "start": "2026-03-11T14:00:00Z", "end": "2026-03-11T15:00:00Z", "title": "Spec review (moved)" }
  }
}
```

`overrides` keys are the *original* occurrence starts, i.e. `RECURRENCE-ID` in
ICS terms — a straight mapping.

### 8.2 Expansion rules (server)

- Expand only inside the requested range, hard-capped at
  `MAX_OCCURRENCES = 750` per event and a 2-year horizon (`invalid_recurrence`
  beyond that).
- Everything is computed in the **event's** timezone, then serialised as UTC.
  This is what makes `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO` stay at 09:00 local across a DST
  change instead of drifting to 08:00/10:00 as a naive UTC expansion does.
- `UNTIL` is inclusive; `COUNT` counts generated instances.

### 8.3 Dependencies (verified)

| Need | Today | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RRULE parsing/expansion (Python) | `python-dateutil` is **not** a declared dependency in `api/pyproject.toml` | Add `python-dateutil>=2.9` (pure-python, MIT, tiny). It ships `dateutil.rrule`, the reference implementation. |
| ICS import/export | not present | Add `icalendar>=6.0` (pure python). Alternatively hand-write the (small) VEVENT/VTIMEZONE subset — decide in M2. |
| Client recurrence | `moment` only (no `moment-timezone`, no `rrule`) | Not needed: the server returns occurrences. |
| Client timezone display | `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in the browser | Use it; no new client dependency. |

> Rule of thumb for this feature: **the browser never does date maths**. It
> formats what the API gives it. That is how the prototype is built too.

### 9.1 Screen anatomy (follows Google Calendar)

├───────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
